title: Prove the clause of a lemma step literal by literal
summary: A lemma step in a long arithmetic or uninterpreted-function refutation is now written in Lean as one chain that proves its clause literal by literal, so its text grows linearly instead of with the square of the clause. The sample's Lean text shrinks from 2,149 to 1,930 MB, and a lemma step over 1,539 literals that Lean used to reject now verifies.
